title.zh: Liquidations jump to $547 million as oil rally hits crypto market
title.en: Liquidations jump to $547 million as oil rally hits crypto market

current_state.zh: Bitcoin fell below $84,000 and total liquidations jumped 235% to $547 million as an Iranian escalation in the Strait of Hormuz pushed Brent crude above $101, with smaller tokens and DeFi/meme indices falling hardest and Optimism dropping 10% after Abstract became the second Ethereum L2 to shut down within a week.
